author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Station Priority Diff (strict selector)
abstract: Re-runs the v0 vs v4 priority diff using strict file selection (pilot-only, no 'diff' files) and robust parsing. Writes MD/JSON outputs.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.diff_priorities import _list_json, _pick_baseline, _pick_compare, load_priorities, diff, write_outputs

files = _list_json()
base = _pick_baseline(files)
cmpf = _pick_compare(files, base) if base else None

if base is None or cmpf is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "Missing baseline or comparison file", "baseline": str(base) if base else None, "compare": str(cmpf) if cmpf else None}, indent=2))
else:
    b_pri, _ = load_priorities(base)
    c_pri, _ = load_priorities(cmpf)
    rows = diff(b_pri, c_pri)
    write_outputs(rows, base, cmpf)
    top = [r for r in rows if r["delta"] is not None]
    top = sorted(top, key=lambda r: abs(r["delta"]), reverse=True)[:5]
    print("=== Adaptive Station Priority Diff (strict) ===")
    print(json.dumps({
        "baseline": str(base),
        "compare": str(cmpf),
        "top_movers": top,
        "out_md": "storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_v0_vs_v4_diff.md"
    }, indent=2))
